name: Maybank Horizon Visa Signature
highlights: S$1 = 7X Points on Air Tickets and Foreign Currency Spend
S$1 = 3X Points on local Shopping, Groceries, Dining, Hotel Bookings
1 Point = 0.4 Miles Rewards to Miles Conversion for Selected Airline Partners
Earn 2.8 air miles (7X TREATS Points) for every S$1 spent on air tickets and foreign currency transactions when you charge a min. of S$800 per calendar month
Earn 1.2 air miles (3X TREATS Points) for every S$1 spent on all local shopping, groceries, dining, hotel bookings and many more
Complimentary lounge access with minimum spend of S$1,000 in a single transaction on a retail purchase, accompanying guest(s) enjoys 20% off walk-in rates for lounge access.
Complimentary Travel Insurance up to S$1,000,000
3 years annual fee waived; spend min. S$18,000 per year to get subsequent waiver

extra.summary: The Maybank Horizon Visa Signature Card is tailored for travelers and those who enjoy dining out and entertainment, offering a variety of benefits. Cardholders can earn greater rewards of up to 2.8 air miles per dollar (7X TREATS Points) on your air tickets and foreign spend when you charge a minimum of S$800 in each calendar month, and enjoy access to lifestyle privileges, complimentary airport lounge visits, travel insurance coverage. Get your Annual Fee waived for 3 years if you spend a min. of S$18,000 per year.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.90% p.a. subject to a minimum charge of S$3.00
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: Available with a total yearly minimum spend of S$18,000
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of outstanding balance or S$20, whichever is higher

minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income: S$60000. Malaysia Citizens (in employment for at least 1 year): S$45,000

our_takes.our-take: Our Take: The Maybank Horizon Visa Signature rewards frequent travellers, especially those who can hit the S$800 monthly spend. Earning 2.8 miles per S$1 on air tickets and foreign currency is competitive. The lounge access, requiring a S$1,000 single transaction, is a nice perk, but limited to one visit per month. Factor in the S$18,000 annual spend to waive the annual fee, otherwise the value proposition diminishes. Consider if your spending aligns mostly with travel to maximize rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travelers seeking air miles and complimentary lounge access for comfortable journeys.
Cardholders who spend over $800 monthly on foreign transactions to maximize air miles.
Professionals who book air tickets regularly and want travel insurance coverage.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A high 27.90% annual interest rate can apply if you carry a balance month to month.
S$18,000 annual spending is needed to waive the S$196.20 fee; factor it into your spending.
Lounge access needs S$1,000 spend in one transaction; access w/o costs S$45 per visit.
